title: Trim clip boundaries in iMovie for Mac
note: Select a timeline clip in iMovie for Mac and choose Window > Show Clip Trimmer to refine its start or end boundaries. The Precision Editor helps adjust edit points and the handles around transitions. Trimming changes the used range, not the original media file.

title: Create a Ken Burns zoom or pan in iMovie
note: Select a clip or photograph, open the Cropping controls and select Ken Burns. Adjust the Start and End crop frames to establish the opening and closing compositions. iMovie animates between them during playback, producing a smooth zoom or pan.

title: Adjust clip volume and keyframes in iMovie
note: In iMovie for Mac, the audio waveform has a horizontal volume line you can drag to raise or lower the level. For volume changes within a clip, press Option and click the line to create keyframes, then adjust the level between keyframes.

title: Insert and configure iMovie transitions
note: Use iMovie's Transitions browser to preview and insert a transition between adjoining timeline clips. A transition can be customized or given a different duration, but it needs sufficient source handles at the edit point for the requested effect.

title: Composite a green-screen shot in iMovie on Mac
note: iMovie for Mac supports Green/Blue Screen as a connected clip effect to replace colored backgrounds. Place the foreground green-screen footage over the background, choose the corresponding overlay mode and refine the selection. Check the Apple guide for available cleanup controls.

title: Stabilize shaky footage in iMovie on Mac
note: iMovie for Mac includes a stabilization setting for reducing unwanted camera shake. Select the relevant footage and use the built-in stabilization controls, then preview the result for cropping or distortion changes. Do not assume this is available on every iMovie platform.
